essence: Each sacred form defined by a vanishing: mantra where letters unnoticed, mudrā where all bodily action dissolved, yoga where breath-flow exhausted — then the festival: for the wise attaining Your abode, everything wonderful.

rasa.sthayibhava: śānta (tranquility) as the festival of the abode
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of festival (utsava); the vyabhicāri is wonder (adbhuta) that everything is wonderful for the wise.
